exposure: home-based telemonitoring management strategy (HBTMS) for postpartum hypertension
standard of care for postpartum hypertension
cohort: 311 postpartum patients at the University Hospital Basel
finding: This interim analysis of the Basel Postpartum Hypertension Cohort demonstrated high acceptance (99%) of a home-based telemonitoring management strategy (HBTMS) for postpartum hypertension.
